subject: Zoning Relief and Special Permit Applications
overview: The Medford Zoning Board of Appeals met to review and vote on several zoning relief applications, including variances and special permits for residential additions, use changes, and commercial projects.

items.title: 114 Mystic Avenue
items.summary: Continued the hearing for a special permit to allow cannabis delivery services at an existing approved cannabis dispensary to July 30th while awaiting legal counsel.

items.title: 31 Boynton Road
items.summary: Approved the applicant's request to withdraw without prejudice their variance application for a 1.5-story addition.

items.title: 39 Ramshead Road
items.summary: Continued the application to the July 30th meeting due to a notification issue.

items.title: 70 Lincoln Road
items.summary: Approved a use variance to construct a second single-family dwelling on an oversized lot, with further review required by the Community Development Board.

items.title: 25 Mystic Street
items.summary: Approved a special permit to construct a two-story deck on an existing non-conforming two-family home.

items.title: 21 Water Street
items.summary: Approved a variance to construct a two-story garage within the front yard setback of a corner lot.

items.title: 493 Main Street
items.summary: Approved a special permit to convert an existing non-conforming single-family dwelling into a two-family dwelling.

items.title: 121 Boston Avenue
items.summary: Approved a special permit to change the use of the property from a non-conforming real estate office to a non-conforming community cafe.

items.title: Approval of Meeting Minutes
items.summary: Tabled the approval of the previous meeting's minutes to the next meeting due to a lack of voting members.
